title: First gameplay!
author: strawberry-ramune
selftext: Yes, I'm bad at my own game, but getting to see the systems interacting for the first time is just so cool!

comments.author: Upbeat-Strain-7999
comments.body: congrats on the first gameplay! being bad at your own game is basically a rite of passage lol. what systems are interacting here?

replies.author: strawberry-ramune
replies.body: Combat, encounter framework, 5 different type of NPC AI (Lord byron, allies, the vanguard, crystal minions, spaceship turrets) Also all the support systems like stuck guarding, combat logging, graphics stuff. Getting to see all the elements come together into something you can actually play is really cool!

replies.author: Upbeat-Strain-7999
replies.body: That's a lot of systems coming together at once! Really curious about the 5 NPC AI types, do they all share one framework or did you build separate behavior logic for each?

replies.author: strawberry-ramune
replies.body: they all share the same interface for movement and whatnot but yes each type has it's own behavior script.

replies.author: Upbeat-Strain-7999
replies.body: nice, shared interface with separate behavior scripts is a clean way to structure that. gives you consistency without forcing every AI into the same mold.
